title: Lacks Functional Quality
text: Lacks Functional Quality. This plastic flatwear is so pretty. I really wanted to like it. Unfortunately, the gold parts come out of the black handles very easily, making them really difficult and awkward to eat with. I was super sad. They look so nice. But what good is a fork if you can’t eat with it? I really wish they had put the time into making the functional quality as nice as the asthetic quality. They are super lightweight, as well. They don’t have a nice feel.
